title: Sum the results of Callable parts on a pool

blocks.text: A `Runnable` returns nothing and cannot throw a checked exception. A `Callable<V>` returns a `V` and may throw any `Exception`. Submitted to an `ExecutorService`, it gives back a `Future<V>`, and `get()` blocks until the result is there, reporting a failure as an `ExecutionException` that **wraps** the exception the task threw. The course's own `SumCallable` sums a range this way.

Write `Totals.total(ExecutorService pool, List<Callable<Integer>> parts)`. It submits **every** part to `pool` first, then waits for each result, and returns their sum as a `long`. If a part throws, `total` throws `IllegalStateException` whose **cause** is the exception that part threw (not the `ExecutionException` around it).

cases.says: It returns the sum of every part's result.
Every part is submitted before the first result is awaited, so the parts run at the same time.
A part that throws makes the call throw IllegalStateException whose cause is that part's own exception.

concepts: A Callable returns a value and may throw checked exceptions; its Future's get() reports a failure as an ExecutionException wrapping the cause.
